Azo compounds contain the functional group R-N=N-R', diazo compounds contain the functional group R-N=N, and hydrazines have the structure R-NH-NH-R'. When these nitrogen-rich compounds react with acids, several hazardous reactions can occur:

1. Azo and diazo compounds can decompose explosively when protonated by acids, releasing nitrogen gas rapidly.
2. Hydrazines are basic compounds that can react exothermically with acids.
3. These reactions can generate heat and potentially lead to explosive decomposition.
4. Some of these reactions can also generate toxic gases.
